in_marathi.name: Ghanshyamansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Cowherds
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ghanshyamansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ghansh means 'Lord of the Cowherds'. Ansh means 'Form' or 'Appearance'. Ghanshyamansh refers to Lord Krishna in his childhood form, living among the cowherds.
